rationale: After 54 minutes in the trade and reaching an MFE of 0.54%, upside momentum has stalled and price has slipped below the 5-minute 9-EMA ($429.75), printing lower highs and lower lows over the last five 1-minute candles. With less than an hour remaining in the session and the initial consolidation failing to hold short-term moving average support, closing at breakeven preserves capital. Flipping to short is unwarranted given the strong institutional buying above session VWAP ($425.00) on 3.07x relative volume.
